data.name: Turn Undead (Mythic)
data.description: The power of your divine energy can not only cause undead to flee but also destroy them where they stand.

raw_tokens.value: The power of your divine energy can not only cause undead to flee but also destroy them where they stand.

When you use Turn Undead, the range increases by %1 feet, and non-mythic undead take a -%2 penalty on their saving throws.&nl;You can expend one use of mythic power when using Turn Undead to destroy undead. Instead of fleeing, undead that fail their saves might be destroyed. You destroy %3d4 Hit Dice worth of undead. Undead with the fewest HD are affected first; among undead with equal HD, those that are closest to the burst's point of origin are affected first. No undead of 9 or more HD can be affected, and HD that aren't sufficient to affect an undead are wasted.|10*MythicLevel|MythicLevel|2*MythicLevel
